# 2 Samuel Chapter 22 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 194v–195r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/2SA_022_page_001.jpg, 2SA_022_page_002.jpg, 2SA_022_page_003.jpg, 2SA_022_page_004.jpg

---

**22:1** And-spoke David to-YHWH the-words of-the-song the-this, on-[the]-day YHWH delivered-him from-[the]-palm of-all his-enemies and-from-[the]-palm of-Sha'ul.

**22:2** And-he-said:
"YHWH [is]-my-rock [sal'i] and-my-fortress [metsudati] and-my-deliverer [mefaltsi] —

**22:3** God [is]-my-rock [tsuri], I-take-refuge in-him;
my-shield [maginni] and-[the]-horn of-my-salvation [yish'i],
my-stronghold [misgabbi] and-my-refuge [menusi],
my-savior [moshi'i] — from-violence [chamas] you-save-me.

**22:4** [The]-praised-one [mehullal] I-call YHWH,
and-from my-enemies I-am-saved.

**22:5** For surrounded-me [the]-breakers of-death [mishberey-mavet],
[the]-torrents of-worthlessness [nachaley beliyya'al] terrified-me.

**22:6** [The]-cords of-Sheol surrounded-me,
confronted-me [the]-snares of-death [moqshey-mavet].

**22:7** In-my-distress [ba-tsar] I-called-upon YHWH,
and-to my-God I-called.
And-he-heard from-his-temple [hekhalo] my-voice,
and-my-cry [shav'ati] [was]-in-his-ears.

**22:8** And-shook [vatirgaz] and-trembled [vatir'ash] the-earth;
[the]-foundations of-the-heavens quaked [yirgazu],
and-they-shook because-he-was-angry [charah].

**22:9** Smoke went-up from-his-nostrils [be-appo],
and-fire from-his-mouth consumed;
coals blazed from-him.

**22:10** And-he-bent [vayet] [the]-heavens and-came-down,
and-thick-darkness [arafal] [was]-under his-feet.

**22:11** And-he-rode upon a-keruv [cherub] and-flew;
and-he-was-seen [vayera'] upon-[the]-wings of-[the]-wind [ruach].

**22:12** And-he-set darkness [choshekh] around-him [as]-booths [sukkot],
gathering of-waters [mayim], thick-clouds of-[the]-skies [avey-shechaqim].

**22:13** From-the-brightness before-him
blazed coals of-fire.

**22:14** Thundered from-[the]-heavens YHWH,
and-[the]-Most-High [Elyon] gave his-voice.

**22:15** And-he-sent arrows [chitstsim] and-scattered-them,
lightning [baraq] and-confused-them [vayehummem].

**22:16** And-were-seen [the]-channels of-[the]-sea,
[the]-foundations of-[the]-world [tevel] were-uncovered,
by-[the]-rebuke of-YHWH,
from-[the]-blast of-[the]-breath [ruach] of-his-nostrils [appo].

**22:17** He-sent from-[the]-height [marom], he-took-me;
he-drew-me [yamsheni] from-waters many.

**22:18** He-delivered-me from-my-enemy [the]-strong,
from-my-haters, for they-were-mightier than-me.

**22:19** They-confronted-me in-[the]-day of-my-calamity [eidi],
and-was YHWH a-support [mish'an] to-me.

**22:20** And-he-brought-me-out to-a-wide-place [merchav];
he-rescued-me [yechalettseni] because he-delighted [chafets] in-me.

**22:21** Rewarded-me [yigmeleni] YHWH according-to-my-righteousness [tsidqati],
according-to-[the]-cleanness of-my-hands [bor yadai] he-returned to-me.

**22:22** For I-kept [the]-ways of-YHWH,
and-I-did-not act-wickedly [rasha'ti] from-my-God.

**22:23** For all his-judgments [mishpatav] [were]-before-me,
and-his-statutes [chuqqotav] — I-did-not turn-aside from-them.

**22:24** And-I-was blameless [tamim] to-him,
and-I-guarded-myself from-my-iniquity [me'avoni].

**22:25** And-returned YHWH to-me according-to-my-righteousness,
according-to-my-cleanness before his-eyes.

**22:26** With-the-loyal [chasid] you-show-yourself-loyal [titchassad],
with-the-blameless warrior [gibbor tamim] you-show-yourself-blameless [tittammam].

**22:27** With-the-pure [navar] you-show-yourself-pure [titbarar],
and-with-the-crooked ['iqqesh] you-show-yourself-twisted [titappal].

**22:28** And-the-afflicted ['ani] people you-save,
and-your-eyes [are]-upon the-haughty [ramim] — you-bring-[them]-low.

**22:29** For you [are]-my-lamp [neri], YHWH,
and-YHWH illumines my-darkness [choshki].

**22:30** For by-you I-run [aruts] a-troop [gedud],
by-my-God I-leap [adallaq] a-wall [shur].

**22:31** The-God — blameless [tamim] [is]-his-way;
[the]-word [imrat] of-YHWH [is]-refined [tserufah];
a-shield [magen] [is]-he to-all the-ones-taking-refuge [ha-chosim] in-him.

**22:32** For who [is]-God apart-from YHWH?
And-who [is]-a-rock [tsur] apart-from our-God?

**22:33** The-God [is]-my-fortress [ma'uzzi] of-strength [chayil],
and-he-sets-free [vayatter] the-blameless [tamim] — his-way.

**22:34** Making my-feet like-the-does [ayyalot],
and-upon my-heights [bamotai] he-stations-me [ya'amideni].

**22:35** Training my-hands for-the-battle [milchamah],
and-bending a-bow of-bronze [nechushah] — my-arms.

**22:36** And-you-gave-me [the]-shield [magen] of-your-salvation [yish'ekha],
and-your-answering [va'anatekha] made-me-great [tarbeni].

**22:37** You-widened my-steps [tsa'adi] beneath-me,
and-my-ankles [qarsullai] did-not slip [ma'adu].

**22:38** I-pursued my-enemies and-destroyed-them [va'ashmideim],
and-I-did-not turn-back until they-were-consumed [kallotam].

**22:39** And-I-consumed-them and-I-shattered-them [va'emchatsem],
and-they-did-not rise;
and-they-fell under my-feet.

**22:40** And-you-girded-me [with]-strength [chayil] for-the-battle;
you-made-bow-down [takhria'] my-opponents [qamay] beneath-me.

**22:41** And-my-enemies — you-gave to-me [the]-back-of-[the]-neck ['oref],
and-my-haters — I-silenced-them [va'atsmitem].

**22:42** They-looked [yish'u] and-there-was-no savior [moshia'],
to YHWH — and-he-did-not answer-them.

**22:43** And-I-ground-them [va'eshchaqem] like-[the]-dust of-the-earth,
like-[the]-mud of-[the]-streets I-crushed-them [adiqqem], I-stamped-them [erqa'em].

**22:44** And-you-delivered-me from-[the]-strivings [merivey] of-my-people;
you-kept-me as-[the]-head of-nations [goyim];
a-people I-knew not shall-serve-me.

**22:45** Sons of-foreignness [beney-nekhar] shall-cringe [yitkchahashu] to-me;
at-[the]-hearing of-[the]-ear they-obey-me [yishma'u].

**22:46** Sons of-foreignness shall-wither [yibbolu],
and-they-shall-gird-themselves [yachgeru] from-their-strongholds [misgrotam].

**22:47** Lives [chay] YHWH, and-blessed [barukh] [is]-my-rock [tsuri],
and-exalted [yarum] [is]-the-God, [the]-rock [tsur] of-my-salvation [yish'i].

**22:48** The-God [is]-the-one-giving vengeance [neqamot] to-me,
and-bringing-down peoples [amim] beneath-me.

**22:49** And-bringing-me-out from-my-enemies;
and-above my-opponents [qamay] you-raise-me;
from-[the]-man of-violence [chamas] you-deliver-me.

**22:50** Therefore I-will-praise-you [odkha], YHWH, among-the-nations [ba-goyim],
and-to-your-name I-will-sing-praise [azammer].

**22:51** [He-is]-a-tower [migdol] of-salvations [yeshu'ot] for-his-king,
and-does covenant-faithfulness [chesed] to-his-anointed [limshicho],
to-David and-to-his-seed forever ['ad-olam].

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.2 — sal'i vs. Psalm 18 selah:** In 2 Sam 22:2 the MT reads סַלְעִי ("my rock" — *sal'i*), while Psalm 18:3 has the same. However, other variants occur throughout: 2 Sam 22:3 reads צוּרִי (*tsuri*), a different word for "rock." The two words are distinct: *sela'* = cliff/crag, *tsur* = bedrock/boulder.

**v.11 — vayera':** The MT of 2 Sam 22:11 reads וַיֵּרָא ("and he was seen / appeared"), whereas Psalm 18:11 reads וַיֵּדֶא ("and he soared"). The single-letter difference (*resh* vs. *daleth*) creates a dramatically different image: "appeared on wings of wind" vs. "soared on wings of wind."

**v.12 — sukkot vs. Psalm 18 savivo:** 2 Sam 22:12 reads "he set darkness around him as booths" (סֻכּוֹת, *sukkot*), while Psalm 18:12 reads "his canopy around him" (סְבִיבוֹתָיו, *sevivotav*). The 2 Samuel reading is lectio difficilior.

**v.26 — titchassad:** The reflexive-reciprocal form of חסד (*chesed*): "you show yourself loyal." God mirrors the character of those who approach him — a profound theological principle rendered through wordplay in the Hebrew.

**v.33 — vayatter:** The MT reads וַיַּתֵּר, likely "and he sets free" or "and he makes complete." Psalm 18:33 reads וַיִּתֵּן ("and he gives"). The textual variants between 2 Samuel 22 and Psalm 18 are numerous throughout this chapter.

**v.36 — va'anatekha:** 2 Sam 22:36 reads "your answering" (עֲנֹתְךָ), while Psalm 18:36 reads "your right hand" (וִימִינְךָ). A significant variant affecting the theology: God's "answering" vs. God's "right hand" supports the petitioner.

**v.51 — migdol:** 2 Sam 22:51 reads מִגְדּוֹל ("tower"), while Psalm 18:51 reads מַגְדִּיל ("who magnifies"). Both readings make sense: God is a "tower of salvations" or "the one who magnifies salvations."

*— EMET*
